Never publish an analysis without verifying ALL numeric claims against MCP live data. Fork agents generating analyses hallucinate financial figures — especially 52W ranges, cash positions, market caps, and support/resistance levels.

**Why:** Session 2026-06-18 — 3 analyses (ALT, IOVA, ALLR) generated by fork agents contained 31 factual errors (9 critical). IOVA had a completely fabricated 52W range ($19.89-$28.89 vs real $1.66-$5.63). ALT confused offering size ($225M) with total cash ($535M), invented support levels, wrong founding year, wrong MASH prevalence. ALLR overstated Pfizer's market cap by $100B+.

**How to apply:**
1. After any fork agent generates an analysis, run the `fact-check-analyses` workflow (adversarial verification)
2. OR at minimum: call GetInstruments + QueryData(types=quote) for the ticker and manually verify: price, 52W range, market cap, cash position, revenue, S/R levels
3. Never trust fork-generated 52W ranges, cash figures, or competitor market caps — these are the most commonly hallucinated
4. Related: [[feedback_no_hallucination]]
